method: Actual Binance USD-M perpetual candles, staged raw depth-observation API, existing worker, live head stream, and native renderers. New Playwright browser context per sample; warm retry reuses that context worker cache.

cases.failed: page.waitForFunction: Target page, context or browser has been closed

limits.frameIntervals: Observed requestAnimationFrame gaps only; no FPS guarantee or inferred frame rate.
limits.memory: Chromium performance.memory JavaScript heap when exposed, worker cache counters, and renderer-retained byte estimates. Excludes total process RSS, GPU surfaces, and some worker/canvas allocations.
limits.rendering: Pi /usr/bin/chromium in Playwright headless mode, without forced SwiftShader arguments. Backend is recorded from the running app.
